record.question:
Which of the two words within brackets in the following sentences is correct in the contexts?
(10x1=10)
(a) Poets often (soar, sore) to great heights of imagination.
(b) Knowledge (proceeds, precedes) from God.
(c) The tower was struck by (lightning, lightening).
(d) Kanpur lies on the air (rout, route) to Kolkata.
(e) Everyone is (jealous, zealous) of him.
(f) The crocodile emerged from the river and (seized, ceased) a goat.
(g) He was found in (collusion, collision) with the plotters.
(h) Wicked persons are not (illegible, eligible) for responsible posts.
(@) He is a man of (lose, loose) character.
(j) The Emperor is staying at the royal (mansion, mention).
